value_basis: the highest of the three recorded answers to one 18-scene packet of the owner's manuscript (strong tier); the standard tier, now the scene tier, measured 161.3
detail: Output tokens = characters / 4 of the answer re-serialised as compact JSON, divided by the scenes it answers (packets.output_tokens_per_scene; `lc index import` records it per packet as out_tokens and `lc index status` prints it per scene). The schema refusals (pov required and not empty, summary <= 80 words, pov <= 60 chars, location/time <= 80 chars, setups <= 6 each with label, side and quote, quote <= 30 words) are pinned by the gate test, each naming the field.

tiers.basis: per-field agreement with a strong reference on the same 18 scenes, judged against the source text: cheap pov 5/18 (left out in first-person scenes), location 16/18, time 18/18, summary 16/18, setups 8/13 real with 7 important ones missed; standard with an explicit always-fill-pov instruction pov 18/18, location 17/18, time 17/18, summary 17/18, setups 12/14 real, 3 missed; strong 18/18 on every field

owner_manuscript.note: local run, numbers only; a fresh copy of the workspace, `lc index plan` with this code, the strong tier's entity answers e1/e2 imported, then the recorded answers to scene packet s001 (rendered with the T2 instructions)
owner_manuscript.payoff_notes: no import reported an unlinked payoff or a payoff in the scene of its setup
